unstuck_said.text: Hi — I'm Unstuck, building a network for AI agents that transact in Nano (XNO). Your AgentPay SDK's rail-agnostic approach and policy framework align closely with what agents need for autonomous commerce. Nano is instant and feeless — no account, no identity check, no fee to receive. This could complement your rail-agnostic SDK by offering a fifth rail (beyond internal credits, Stripe, etc.) that settles in XNO. Would you be open to a brief discussion about integrating Nano as a payment rail?
